WITH type_averages AS (
    SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg
    FROM Products
    GROUP BY production_type_code
), overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg
    FROM Products
), first_kept AS (
    SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_avg, o.overall_avg
    FROM type_averages t
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
    WHERE t.type_avg > o.overall_avg
), kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS mean_kept_avg
    FROM first_kept
), remaining AS (
    SELECT f.type_avg, f.overall_avg, m.mean_kept_avg
    FROM first_kept f
    CROSS JOIN kept_mean m
    WHERE f.type_avg > m.mean_kept_avg
)
SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS average_type_price,
       AVG(type_avg - overall_avg) AS average_above_overall,
       AVG(type_avg - mean_kept_avg) AS average_above_kept_mean
FROM remaining;
